Class Card

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.model.cards.Card
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
Direct Known Subclasses:
Building, Character, Event
public abstract class Card extends Object implements Serializable
Represents an abstract game card with its basic properties. This class serves as a base for all specific card types in the game. Concrete subclasses of this class are intended to be created from JSON data.

    • getResolutionPriority

      public int getResolutionPriority()
      Returns the resolution priority of this card when discarded. Cards with lower priority are resolved first. Default is 0. Subclasses (e.g., Event) can override this to control discard ordering.
      Returns:
      The resolution priority.

    • getTriggerKey

      public Optional<TriggerKey> getTriggerKey()
      Trigger key associated with this card, if any. Event and Building cards override this to return their key.
      Returns:
      an Optional containing the TriggerKey, or empty if not applicable

    • onDiscard

      public boolean onDiscard(GameState state)
      Handles the logic when a card is discarded. By default, it simply returns true. Subclasses can override this to implement specific behavior (e.g., Events).
      Parameters:
      state - The current game state.
      Returns:
      True if the discard action was processed successfully.

    • onAddedToPlayer

      public boolean onAddedToPlayer(Player p)
      Hook invoked when this card is added to a player's hand. Default is a no-op; character subclasses override to update player stats.
      Parameters:
      p - the player receiving the card
      Returns:
      true on success

    • addToDeck

      public boolean addToDeck(Decks manager)
      Adds this card to the given deck manager using the Visitor pattern, so each subclass routes itself to the correct collection (cards or buildings) without type checks. The base implementation registers a generic card.
      Parameters:
      manager - the deck manager to add this card to
      Returns:
      true if the card was added, false if its age is not set

    • isBuyable

      public boolean isBuyable()
      Indicates whether this card can be bought/picked by a player. Default is true; non-buyable cards (e.g. events) override this.
      Returns:
      true if the card is buyable

    • getId

      public CharacterEnum getId()
      Polymorphic accessor for the character type. Returns null for non-character cards; Character overrides to return its enum id. Callers that need null-safety should use Comparator.nullsLast(Comparator.naturalOrder()).
